ex {
	import "fmt"
	var x int
	fmt.Println(x) -> fmt.Printf("%d\n", x)
}
-- x.go --
package p

import "fmt"

func F() {
	fmt.Println(1)
	fmt.Println(1, 2)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
